name: ckz_gate_debug
_design: DIAGNOSTIC. Run with CKZ_GATE_DEBUG=1 to print the per-step sigma->strength toggle + buffer readback. gate=0.95 turns LoRA off for ONLY the first 1-2 highest-noise steps; if even that kills cKz timbre, the early steps are decisive (hypothesis-limited, not a bug). 1.0 = control.
